thread:
Ana V: ACME follow-up: they need a Private packaging flow that guarantees stable egress IPs for webhook allowlists and supports safe, incremental operator upgrades. asked for timeline next sprint.
Julien T: can we confirm "stable egress" means preserved NAT mapping (same external IP) vs passthrough? affects installer changes.
Ana V: they prefer NAT with stable mapping. fallback to relay if customer can't preserve mappings.
Priya M: plan sketch: installer flag + operator CRD template + post-upgrade verification steps. verification = webhook echo + egress IP check + config checksum. if any fail, auto-rollback.
Darren L: how to handle airgap installs (no outbound)? we should support a verification proxy that runs locally and returns a signed result blob.
Priya M: yes. add "verification_proxy" field to the template. proxy runs an echo endpoint inside customer infra. operator polls for signed result.
infra-bot: note: schema change proposed: network_template.v2 -> added fields: "egress_mode","verification_proxy","upgrade.timeout". staging schema posted.
Julien T: upgrade timeout default? auto-rollback window?
Priya M: default 10m, configurable via template param. require explicit override for >1h to avoid stuck rollouts.
Darren L: test plan: (1) staging customer deploy with template; (2) run webhook roundtrip and assert external IP consistent; (3) simulate BGP flap and ensure auto-rollback; (4) test airgap proxy flow.
Ana V: launch criteria: schema validated in 2 customers, rollback tested E2E, docs + quickstart + NetOps runbook ready.
Julien T: dependency: runtime needs checkpoint API for operator to snapshot config/state pre-upgrade. is that on infra backlog?
Priya M: I'll open a spike ticket for the checkpoint endpoint and minimal KV sync hook.
Darren L: will draft verification tests and sample BGP snippet. include ipam overlap checks in troubleshooting.
Ana V: prioritization: mark high if it unlocks ACME deal; otherwise medium. I'll coordinate with sales.
Priya M: action items: spike ticket + schema PR + docs stub. ping when ready for sprint planning.
infra-bot: archived to product/packaging on close. :white_check_mark:
